Description: The number of molecules in the extracted cluster
The radius of gyration of the molecular centroids of the cluster
The largest centroid-centroid distance within the cluster
The number of molecule-molecule contacts (edges of the contact graph) within the cluster
The topology of the cluster's contact graph (chain / ring / star / paw / diamond / K4 or e<edges> for larger clusters)
The number of contacts of the most-connected molecule within the cluster (its degree in the induced contact graph): 3 for a star tetramer or a 4-star's centre has 4
The degree sequence of the cluster's contact graph in descending order (hyphen separated)
The stratification bin (0-based) of the spread coordinate this cluster was accepted into
The indices of the molecules in the source configuration making up the cluster (hyphen separated)
